text: 1、市场早间低开回升，三大指数涨跌互现。培育钻石概念股走强，黄河旋风、恒盛能源、恒林股份涨停。MLCC概念延续涨势，双星新材2连板，康达新材涨停。创新药概念拉升，万邦医药、三力制药涨停。汽车整车股反弹，安凯客车、众泰汽车、海马汽车涨停。下跌方面，农业股迎来调整，敦煌种业、新农开发跌停。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市约3600股飘红，上午半天成交1.11万亿。午间收盘沪指涨0.16%，深成指跌0.25%，创业板跌0.47%。 2、板块概念方面，培育钻石、MLCC、创新药、汽车整车等板块领涨；军工、农业、旅游、影视等板块领跌； 3、两市共3362只个股上涨，50只
text_en: 1. The market opened lower in the morning and rebounded, with the three major indices mixed. Lab-grown diamond concept stocks strengthened, with Huanghe Whirlwind, Hengsheng Energy, and Henglin Home Furnishings hitting the daily limit up. The MLCC concept continued its rally, with Shuangxing New Materials posting a second consecutive daily limit up and Kangda New Materials hitting the daily limit up. Innovative drug concept stocks surged, with Wanbang Pharmaceutical and Sanli Pharmaceutical hitting the daily limit up. Automobile whole-vehicle stocks rebounded, with Ankai Bus, Zotye Auto, and Haima Automobile hitting the daily limit up. On the decline, agricultural stocks underwent a correction, with Dunhuang Seed and Xinnong Development hitting the daily limit down. More stocks rose than fell, with about 3,600 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing trading higher, and half-day turnover of 1.11 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index was up 0.16%, the Shenzhen Component Index was down 0.25%, and the ChiNext Index was down 0.47%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, lab-grown diamonds, MLCC, innovative drugs, and automobile whole vehicles led the gains; military industry, agriculture, tourism, and film and television led the declines; 3.
